hints.text: Each factor has one decimal place, so the answer needs $1 + 1 = 2$ decimal places.

explanation: Count decimal places: one in $0.3$ plus one in $0.4$ makes two.
Move in two places from the right of $12$, writing a zero in front: $0.12$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Fraction view
steps: $\frac{3}{10} \times \frac{4}{10} = \frac{12}{100} = 0.12$ ✓ — the hundredths explain the two decimal places.
